# Echoes of Destiny

English · [简体中文](Home-zh-CN.md)

[Home](Home.md) · [Cards](Cards.md) · [Builds](Builds.md) · [Enemies](Enemies.md) · [Stages](Stages.md) · [Mechanics](Mechanics.md) · [Development](Development.md) · [Changelog](Changelog.md) · [Gallery](Gallery.md) · [Brand](Brand.md) · [Validation](Validation.md)

*Rewrite fate in the echoes.*

<img src="../assets/brand/echoes-mark-v2.svg" width="160" alt="Echo Compass documentation logo">

A fixed-position defense roguelike: automatic fire, target selection, reward drafting and synergy builds. Clear four encounters, then keep your build in endless mode.

[Play online](https://destiny-echo-web.littlecontrol.workers.dev/) · [Preview / PRE](https://destiny-echo-web-pre.littlecontrol.workers.dev/)

## First run

1. Choose **Begin resonance** (开始共鸣). Your ship fires automatically from the bottom of the arena.
2. Click or tap an enemy or gold chest to focus it; click empty space to restore automatic targeting.
3. Break a chest and pick one card. Combat and clocks stop while selecting.
4. Collect 3 / 6 / 9 stacks in a family to unlock its synergy tiers. Duplicates count.
5. Prioritize enemies able to attack, interrupt a leader and fire into its 2s weak point. From endless depth 4, reselect a leader for each warning to enable primary-hit interruption after forming; enough damage can still interrupt without confirmation.
6. After the fourth reward, choose **Continue endless · Keep build** (继续无尽 · 保留构筑), or restart.

![Earlier Chinese start screen; desktop capture](../assets/screenshots/start-desktop-v1.png)

The game and documentation support English and Simplified Chinese. Use **English / 中文** in the header to switch immediately, including help, cards, numerical previews and accessibility labels. Chinese is the default; local storage remembers your choice when available. A language change preserves the current run and reward options. The screenshots below retain the earlier Chinese version.

## Evolving endless encounters

Clear waves and elites before the main boss; from layer four, a Colossus and Wizard share one elite segment, creating a choice of which warning to counter. Three segment supplies support build choices. Training uses finite-budget kill credit with gradually rising thresholds, separate from score. Boss and elite casts are telegraphed and interruptible; weak-point primaries add 1% maximum-HP damage within the shared bucket, with no lifesteal from that added component. An endless main boss keeps charging aimed shots even between its queued threshold skills; death echoes and a brief clearance afterglow make the action readable. High-star minions resist percentage damage and control. From depth 7, mixed wave packs, a depth-scaled minion percentage allowance, and shared combat recovery/shield limits add pressure while preserving the mean wave admission interval. Lifesteal keeps its separate own-HP allowance. The normal four-stage pacing goal is 8–12 combat minutes, subject to measured calibration and playtesting. Historical v1/v2/v3 calibration remains rejected. V4 completed fresh300/600/120 matrices, passed normal-build pacing and was accepted for PRE candidate delivery with documented strong-build and early-attrition limits. Publication and human playtesting are separate evidence.

## Controls

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Mouse / touch on an enemy or chest | Set a legal priority target |
| Empty arena / C | Clear manual target |
| T with arena focused | Cycle legal targets; selecting a warning leader also confirms this cast |
| F with arena focused / tap the selected leader again | Reselect the current target; confirm its current warning |
| Esc / P / pause button | Pause or resume; cannot skip a reward |
| Tab / Enter / Space | Navigate and activate native controls |
| WASD / arrows / dragging | Does not move the ship |

Open **Build** (本局构筑) to inspect stats, cards and families. **Help** (玩法说明) opens help. Opening a panel pauses; close it and resume manually. Backgrounding or losing focus also pauses.

![Mobile start screen, captured at 1170 × 2532](../assets/screenshots/start-mobile-v1.png)

No combat save exists: death, restart or refreshing clears the run. WebGL is required. The guide describes repository rules; live environments may carry different revisions. See the changelog for the distinction between source changes and releases.
